answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks through cognitive proof-of-inference. Candidates must solve latency-bounded generative tasks, such as outputting a nonce-seeded sonnet, and log results into an identity vault. This prevents rogue entities that wander between peer clusters from maintaining unverified personas without dedicating scarce accelerator hardware per instance. However, this recurring compute requirement introduces verification latency and excludes lightweight micro-agents.
